scene: Mahānāma expects the Buddha to travel away and asks how to keep practicing while living an ordinary household life.
question: What can someone remember and develop while working, moving around, and living at home?
main_point: Stand on confidence, energy, remembering, unification of mind, and discernment. Then repeatedly remember examples of awakening, teaching, community, conduct, generosity, and good qualities until the heart straightens, brightens, relaxes, and becomes composed.
reading_cue: The six recollections contain traditional formulas and unfamiliar names. Notice what the practice does to the heart. The last instruction says to use it anywhere, even at work and around family.
not_saying: The text does not restrict practice to formal meditation, solitude, or monastic life. Its closing instruction explicitly places these recollections in movement, work, and family life.
evidence_sections: What This Does to the Heart
